independent_source_reads: native_cpu_action _scope captures full request metadata; intent/READY/terminal writers watch the exact request; actual GO rechecks current action/domain/claim; terminal commit/effect confirmation precedes budget settlement.

execution_authority watcher is read-only and permits only exact source task or exact target task under same scope; commit-time validation uses actual writer connection, with no cross-task write lease.

limits: Bounded metadata/receipt checks do not verify current artifact file bytes; Domain dispatch still uses strong captured sources and sealed worker-only FDs.
Raw configuration/specification identity does not hermetically pin arbitrary executable dependencies or prove identical scientific conditions.
Explicit admission does not spend budget or start workers; later dispatch independently reserves and checks stop/admission. A queued replica can remain unaffordable.
No controller adoption, cross-database dedup/resource namespace, automatic retry of uncertain writes, GPU/provider, holdout access, or scientific improvement claim.
Concurrent test uses two real SQLite connections plus the existing same-source effect lock; not a cross-host fault campaign.
